content:
It's three o'clock in the afternoon. Trang puts her hand on her head and closes her eyes.

Her friend Quan asks, "Are you OK?"
"I have a headache again. I get one every afternoon."
"How much water do you drink at work?"
"Water? Maybe one glass. I drink tea at lunch."
"That's not enough. When you don't drink enough water, you get a headache. It happens to me too."
"Really? How much do you drink?"
He shows her a big bottle. "Two of these every day. If I drink a glass every hour, my head feels fine."
"But I forget!"
"Then use your phone. My phone rings every hour, and I go to the kitchen for water. When I walk to the kitchen, I move my legs too."
Trang laughs. "That's clever. Can you give me a bottle?"
Quan says, "Of course. Here you are. Fill it in the kitchen and drink!"

grammarStep.questionVi: Câu điều kiện loại 0 nào nói về điều Trang không làm?
options: When you don't drink enough water, you get a headache.
When I walk to the kitchen, I move my legs too.
If I drink a glass every hour, my head feels fine.
grammarStep.explanationVi: Vế when có phủ định: don't drink. Kết quả: get a headache.
grammarStep.whenVi: Dùng If / When + hiện tại đơn để nói nguyên nhân – kết quả luôn đúng. Vế if có thể phủ định (don't / doesn't).

grammarStep.noteVi: Enough đứng trước danh từ: enough water, enough sleep. Đứng sau tính từ: old enough, big enough.

writingHelp.modelAnswer: I drink about six glasses of water every day. I always have a big bottle in my bag. When I drink enough water, I feel fresh and happy. If I don't drink enough, I get a headache in the afternoon. In summer, I drink more water because it is very hot.
